todo: - 26:177a8 (S104): translator softened a source contradiction (tanuki named after Yoshida vs 'Ponkichi') — accuracy review: translate as written.

rows.en:
He'd gotten it all wrong, you see.
He'd mixed up what 'paraded through town' meant—he thought it meant being dragged around.
He started pedaling as hard as he could along the walking trail, where hardly anyone ever came.
At first, Ponkichi ran for dear life and kept up.
But soon its legs couldn't keep pace, and finally it started being dragged.
Getting carried away, the guy went faster and faster and faster.
Ponkichi shrieked, frantically trying to run.
But once the bike hit the downhill slope, it sped along at a terrific speed.
Ponkichi tumbled belly-down, then back-down, until its whole body was scraped into a raw mess.
By the time the guy had made one lap of the trail on the hill behind the school, Ponkichi had passed out and hung limp.
Apparently all its fur had been torn off, and it was covered in blood.{p}

Even that wasn't enough for the guy. He took it back to the restroom and hung it from the entrance of a stall.
He probably wanted to crucify it, but there was nowhere to nail it up.{p}
"Hey, say something, why don't you."{p}

And then Ponkichi was found by the boy who'd been taking care of it.
"Ponkichi! Ponkichi☆"
Ponkichi was dead, still hanging there.
Covered in blood from head to tail, looking as if it had hanged itself.
"How could anyone do something so horrible?
What would it take to leave it like this..."
He was devastated.
Then he made a grave beside the restroom and buried it.{p}

Then a few days went by.
All that time, he never once missed visiting the grave.{p}

That day after school, too, he went over to the restroom to visit the grave.
And there was someone wrecking the grave.
Furious, he ran right up to the guy.
"What do you think you're doing?!"
His face bright red, he told him off.
But the guy just got angry right back and punched him.
And then he said,
"I'm the one who killed the tanuki,"
just like that.
When he heard that, he went at the guy with his fists.
But he was no match for him at all.{p}

Instead, he got beaten to a pulp and dragged into the restroom.
The guy must have figured he'd beat him all he liked, where no one could see.
And he kept on beating him.
So much that the whole restroom ended up covered in blood.{p}
After that, he stayed home from school for a few days, until the swelling went down.{p}
And when he went back to school, everyone was talking about a certain male student.{p}

On his way home from school on his bike, that student got caught by a dump truck and dragged for several hundred meters.
Naturally, by the time they found him, he was dead.
But you know, according to people who saw him being dragged, he was still alive while it was happening.
They say he was screaming.
Horrible, isn't it?
I wonder what it feels like to be dragged around alive.
It must hurt so much you can't think of anything at all.{p}

That student, see—he was the one who killed Ponkichi.
By coincidence, he died the same way Ponkichi did.
Do you think that's just a coincidence?
I sure don't.{p}

For some reason, they say he's in there, desperately apologizing to something.
"I'm sorry... I'm sorry,"
like that.
So nobody goes near that restroom anymore.{p}
Actually, this story isn't over yet.{p}Would you like to hear the rest, {a}{f:|}?
I've had enough
Please tell me more

Okay, okay, got it.
I'll tell you.{p}

One of the classmates of the boy who looked after the tanuki was a girl named Namiko Yoshida...
Right around when Ponkichi started showing up at school, she stopped coming to school.
He was worried about her.
Because he liked Yoshida, you see.
After a while, a rumor started going around that she'd gone missing.
And it seemed it was no mere rumor, but the truth.
He was terribly worried, but in the end, she was never found.
And then that incident happened.
The one where Ponkichi was killed.{p}

The truth is, he'd secretly named that tanuki after her.
He could never bring himself to confess his feelings to Yoshida.
So instead, he named the tanuki after her and doted on it, to fool himself about how he felt.
Pathetic, isn't it...
I guess he got lonely once Yoshida was gone.{p}

He began tending the grave of the tanuki he'd named after Yoshida even more devotedly than before.
On windy days, on rainy days.
It was as if he meant to keep it up until she really appeared.
And then she really did appear.
She did............
That day, too, after school when everyone had gone, he was tending the grave alone.
That was when someone spoke to him from behind.
"...You always take such good care of it............
Thank you..."{p}

When he turned around, there stood Yoshida.
"Yoshida☆"
Startled, he started to rush over to her.
"Wait.
People will see us here.
This way..."
She led him inside that restroom.{p}

"You took care of the tanuki here, didn't you..."
"Huh..."
He was stunned.
How did she know about that?
After all, she'd gone missing before the tanuki ever showed up at school.
"How do you know that..."
he asked her.{p}

"I was watching the whole time.
Watching you take care of it.
No—I was the one you were taking care of...
...That tanuki was me..."
He was so confused he had no idea what was going on.
"Huh? What?
Wait a second...
I don't understand what you mean..."
"...Yes.
I can't blame you.
It's an unbelievable story, after all.
You see, I'm actually dead.
What's standing here like this is my soul...
What people call a ghost..."
That's right—the one who'd appeared there was Yoshida's ghost.
And she began to talk.
About how she had come to die.{p}

"One day, I found a tanuki.
...At school.
Its leg was badly hurt.
It must have been hit by a car or something.
When I went closer to treat it, it limped off toward the hill out back, desperately trying to get away.
It had something like food in its mouth...{p}

The injured tanuki had been bringing food to her cubs.
Coming all the way down to where people live.{p}
On the way, she was hit by a car.{p}

Once the mother tanuki gave her cubs the food, she died, looking relieved.
I felt so sorry for that tanuki.
So I decided to bring them food in her place.
They didn't look like they could find food on their own yet, after all.
Every day, I went up into the hill out back and fed them.{p}

It was a rainy, terribly damp day.
I was bringing them food as usual.
And then... the long rain had loosened the ground...
I slipped and fell down a cliff.
I remember the blood gushing from my head.
That's when I thought it.
I'm going to die.
And if I die, who'll take care of those little ones?
That's what I was thinking about, even as I was dying.
Then the spirit of that injured tanuki appeared before me.
The mother tanuki's love for her cubs and my feelings became one, and a miracle happened.{p}

I came back to life as a tanuki.
Or maybe I possessed some other tanuki.
Either way, I could keep bringing food to those cubs.
And then you found me.{p}

You shut me up in this restroom, and I couldn't bring them food anymore.
Do you think I hated you?
You hated me
You didn't hate me

That's right, I didn't hate you.
No, that's not quite true.
At first, I did hate you.
I'd finally been able to bring food to the cubs, and then this.
But soon, that hatred faded away.
Because you called me by my name...{p}

At first, I was worried you'd realized I'd turned into a tanuki.
But that didn't seem to be it.
You'd only given the tanuki my name because you were pining for me.
I was happy.
When I found out there was someone who cared about me.
Honestly, sometimes I thought, if only I'd known before I died... but you took such devoted care of me that I didn't mind.{p}

...But because of a heartless boy, I had to die all over again.
You know about that too, don't you.{p}

Even so, you made me a grave and took care of it every day like this.
Thanks to you, I think I'll be able to pass on..."
"Huh? Pass on...?"
Hearing that she would pass on shook him.
He'd finally been able to see Yoshida again, and now she was going to pass on...
Even if she was a ghost, he wanted to be with her.
"Yes. Thanks to you, I can rest in peace and pass on.
Thank you...
I wanted to tell you that, so today I appeared before you like this."
"No!
I thought I'd finally gotten to see you, and now I'll never see you again...
You don't have to pass on.
Stay with me forever!"
He begged Yoshida desperately.{p}What do you think she said?
I can't do that
All right

"All right...
Thank you.
I'm so happy you care about me that much.
But promise me just this one thing.
No matter what happens, don't ever come to hate me."
"I promise.
I'll never, ever hate you.
I promise.
So stay with me forever..."
She agreed.
On one condition: she couldn't leave that restroom.
He was overjoyed.
But he should have thought it through.
What it meant for her to stay there instead of passing on.
Every day after school, he went to that restroom to meet her.
Just as if they were going on dates.
That went on for several months.{p}

But you know, little by little, her face began to change.
Gradually, it took on a vicious look.
Little by little, he came to be afraid of her.
Even her slightest gestures, even her smile, began to fill him with fear.
She noticed that about him, too.
So she pressed him on it.
You'll never come to hate me, no matter how long it's been, will you?
But you know, when he saw her face at that moment, he flinched.
It felt like she was threatening him.
And that made her furious.{p}

"You said so!
You said you'd never hate me.
And yet you...
You... Youuuu☆"
She lunged at him.
Her face was no longer the face she'd had.
It was like a demon's...
It was a face that didn't look human at all.{p}

Somehow he managed to get away.
That's how he survived.
She'd gone so long without passing on that low-level spirits must have gotten to her.
That has to be why she turned out like that.{p}

They say she still appears.
In that restroom—the ghost of Yoshida, who became a tanuki...
Because she can't pass on.
He doesn't visit the grave anymore either, so I bet there's not a trace of it left now, don't you think?
Anyway, that restroom is haunted.
By the boy's ghost, and by Yoshida's ghost.
It's especially dangerous if you run into Yoshida's ghost.
No matter who's in there, she'll lunge at them.
And if she gets you, they say she rips your soul out.
Not that I really know.
When new students come in, they don't know about that restroom, so they use it.
And if they're unlucky enough to meet her ghost, they collapse dead, as if their soul had been ripped out.
The school says they slipped and hit their heads, though.{p}

...Do you know how I know this story?
The truth is, the boy who took care of that tanuki was me.
That all happened just a year ago.
So it's true. That restroom really is haunted.
I'm warning you.
You'd better not go to that restroom.
Not unless you want to die.
...And that's the end of my story.
The next person is finally the last one.
Well then, I'll leave it to you.{p}

I see...
The important part was coming up next, though.
Oh well, I understand.
There's no point making you listen if you don't want to.
But I'm warning you.
Whatever you do, don't go to that restroom.
That much, I'm telling you.{p}

Well, that's the end of my story.
Now it's finally the last person.
I wonder what kind of story they'll tell?
I'm looking forward to it.
Still, the seventh person never showed up, huh.
I wonder what happened?
I hope nothing bad happened to them.{p}

So, on to the next person—and they're finally the last one.
That is, if the seventh person doesn't show.
But it's this late already, so there's no way they're coming.
Okay, the next person is the last.
Let's hurry up and finish so we can go home.
Mama will be worried about me at home.
Next person, go ahead.{p}

Oh, okay.
Did it make you feel sick?
Or were you scared?
Either way, I'm telling you this much.
You'd better not go to that restroom.
Not ever.
If you do go to that restroom and something happens, I won't take responsibility.
That's how dangerous it is.{p}

...But personally, I'd like you to go, {a}{f:|}.
I don't know what would happen either, but I bet something terrible would.
Heh heh heh heh heh...
Well then, I'll end my story here.
Next person, if you please.{p}

Fine, then I won't tell it.
Maybe a story like this just doesn't interest you, {a}{f:|}?
Sorry. These are the only kind of stories I know.
I don't mind, really, so
you don't need to feel bad about turning me down.
It's just that my story was boring...
But listen, {a}{f:|}.
Stay away from that restroom, at least.
That restroom, of all places.{p}

Well, that's the end of my story.
I guess it was a boring one...
I'm sure the next person's story will be more interesting.
I can't wait...{p}

At first, I thought you'd figured it out.
That I'd turned into a tanuki.
But no.
You had a crush on me, didn't you?
That's why you gave the tanuki my name.
Am I wrong?
It's laughable.
You're so pathetic it's unreal.
Every time you called me by my name, it made me want to throw up.
It made every hair on my body stand on end.
...What?
Don't tell me you're crying?
Hah... You're exactly the kind of person I thought you were.
Pathetic, wishy-washy...
And you call yourself a man?
.......................
Well, there's no point saying any of this.{p}

If you want the whole truth, you're the one who killed me, too.
If you hadn't held me captive, I'd never have met such a horrible fate.
Yes, what you were doing was holding me captive.
I hate you... I hate you... I hate you☆"
With that, she attacked him.{p}

She choked him by the neck with unbelievable strength.
"...Gk... hkk..."
He struggled desperately, but the grip on his throat didn't weaken in the slightest.
She glared at him with a hideous expression.
And that face began to crumble, more and more.
Like watching a special-effects movie, her skin rotted and sloughed off in slimy sheets.
But unlike in a movie, there was the smell.
Even though he couldn't breathe, the faintest whiff reaching his nostrils was enough to make him gag.{p}

Maybe that was a stroke of luck, because the moment he thrashed, her hands came loose.
No, to be precise, her hands rotted and tore off.
"Guoooooh... I talked for too long...
I can't hold this body together...
Damn it... damn it all.
Someday... I swear..........."
The voice was so hoarse it was hard to believe it was hers.
A voice that seemed to echo up from the bottom of hell.{p}

He didn't look back—he just tore out of the restroom.
And somehow he made it home and was saved.
They say she's still in that restroom, even now.
She is.
Desperately regenerating her rotted-away body.
Anyone who comes near gets drained by her without mercy.
Drained of their life force, that is.
And once she's revived, she means to take her revenge on him.
She ought to be reviving any time now, don't you think?
Maybe the seventh person is actually her.
.......................{p}

Hahahahaha. Why are you looking so serious?
I'm joking, just joking.{p}

...But the part about Yoshida being in that restroom is true.
So you must never go near that restroom.
Never... never, I mean it...
There, that's the end of my story.
Now there's just one left.
That went faster than I expected, huh.
I thought it would take a lot longer.
So, {a}{f:|}.
Could you ask the next person to go?{p}

"I can't do that.
If I stay here, I may never be able to pass on.
And if I stay forever, something terrible will happen..."
That's what she said.
"I know.
You can come with me.
I'll take you with me.
That'll be all right, won't it!"
He was overjoyed.
If he could be with her, he didn't care if he died.
So he decided to let her take him along.
"All right, then.
I'll take you.
But promise me.
I'm going to take you with me now, but you mustn't open your eyes until I say it's okay.
If you don't promise me that, I can't take you."
He promised right away.
That he absolutely wouldn't open his eyes.{p}

And he closed his eyes.
Then she came close and gently cupped his face in both hands.
And pressed her forehead to his.
He stayed still, eyes closed.{p}

After a while, she began muttering some kind of chant.
And then, all around him, there came eerie laughter and the sound of things running around.
He couldn't stop wondering what it was.
Even so, he held out.
He kept his eyes shut tight with all his might.{p}

But you know, little by little, a rank, fishy stench rose up.
It was so bad he thought his nose would twist right off.
And that smell, it seemed, was coming from her.
Unable to bear it, he tried to pull away from her.
But she held his head tight and wouldn't let him go.
"...It's almost done, so be patient..."
That wasn't her voice.
It was a horribly hoarse voice, one that seemed to echo up from the bottom of hell.
Startled, he opened his eyes.{p}

"Gyaah☆"
There she stood, almost nothing left of her but bare bones.
Scraps of flesh clung here and there, giving off a hideous smell.
"...Why did you open your eyes...
We were almost there..."
She was furious, the hair still stuck to her skull standing on end.
He tried desperately to get away from her.
But she wouldn't let go.
Still, he shoved her away with all his strength, trying to break free.
Then her arm came off at the elbow, and at last he got loose.
And he frantically ran out of the restroom and was saved.{p}

She had been betrayed.
And in her deep grief, she stayed on in that restroom.
Even now, she's in that restroom as a tanuki, waiting for him to come back.
And they say if any student comes in, it doesn't matter who, she tries to take them with her.
So you'd better stay away from that restroom too, {a}{f:|}.
They say just going near it can be enough for her to call you.
...And that's the end of my story.
Next is finally the very last one.
That is, if the seventh person doesn't come.
But at this rate, it doesn't look like they will.{p}

So, {a}{f:|}. Please ask the next person.
I kind of want to go home now.{p}
